notes.title: .35k
notes.notes:
- changed title and added title music
- started adding the new sound fx in.  No more little blip when Jessica swings her baton, and check out that beefy handgun sound.
- added feedback sound for when an attack does not kill an enemy
- Jessica moves faster
- Desert stage lengthened, you still can't get to the boss and unlock that power yet
- last patch you could use herbicide bombs without picking the powerup up.  whoops!

notes.title: 0.35e - We are back!
notes.notes:
- a LOT of the game was lost, but I think I got it back to where it was before
- you probably need a new save
- added the beginnings of a new area
- Jessica's Ki now regenerates very slowly.  Will work on regen rate powerups maybe?

notes.title: Update .35c
notes.notes: - Gird your loins for battle, because enemies are actually trying to kill you now!

notes.title: Update .35b
notes.notes:
- Added new enemy type to hub level
- Pickups no longer appear at all if you already have full health/Ki

notes.title: Update for .35a
notes.notes:
- Many many movement and collision bugs repaired: character will no longer fall through architecture so much and should not flail when walking on objects

- can swing baton during falling part of jump now.

notes.title: .35 Update!

notes.title: Update May 05, Version .33
notes.notes:
Steaming along!

- Added a small help/tutorial section at the beginning
- Added save rooms... meet my dear departed cat Bonecrusher!
- Fiddled with teleporter code
- Fiddled with Ki restoration powerups

notes.title: 0.32m
notes.notes:
- changed fall animation so it does not trigger based on a time since jump pressed, instead after peak of jump.

 - added more forgiveness to the jump controls and walking off the ledge.  If you miss your jump you've still got a tenth of a second to fix it.  Same with walking off a ledge.  Once you see the falling animation kick in you know it's too late.

- frame buffer for jumping and attacking, this results in less "hey!  I pushed that button why didn't it happen?" issues.

- modification of hitbox on crouching attack.
